name: import-pane-in-dark-mode
description: The import pane previews a staged Arc folder in dark mode. The pane uses only the shared settings tokens, so the capture is the dark theme evidence.

actions.note: Atrium frontmost, or cmd+comma opens Finder Settings

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="import"]'); if (!item) { return 'no import rail item'; } item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: evidence: the Arc card with its counts, dark mode

assertions.expected: "3 spaces, 6 tabs, 2 favourites, 4 routing rules and 2 profiles"
